hypothesis: A source-period-normalized causal prefix extending beyond the eight copied parent anchors contains enough parent-residual information for a rank-4 closed-form POD solve to strictly reduce unobserved-suffix aggregate relative L2 on fresh train groups.
mechanism: fit family-specific rank-4 parent residual modes offline using train truth
exclude the eight exactly copied anchor frames from the online inverse problem
solve four coefficients from the newly observed causal prefix with relative ridge regularization
apply the inferred correction only to the still-unobserved suffix
clip future correction energy to five percent of frozen-parent future energy
fall back exactly to the frozen parent when the observed objective does not improve

parent_selection_rule.variant_gate: both seeds must strictly beat the same-cache warp-anchor aggregate
parent_selection_rule.variant_choice: among passing variants choose the smallest worst-seed best aggregate
parent_selection_rule.seed_choice: within the chosen variant use the seed with the smaller best aggregate

accuracy_and_selection.arm_pass: adapted aggregate relative L2 on each record's unobserved suffix must be strictly below its frozen-parent aggregate; no minimum percentage
accuracy_and_selection.calibration_choice: among passing arms choose the lowest adapted aggregate on the common frames 49:64; break ties by smaller mean observed_count
accuracy_and_selection.confirmation_pass: the frozen selected arm must strictly improve aggregate relative L2 on fresh confirmation groups; no minimum percentage
report_only: mean and nearest-rank P95 end-to-end runtime

data.historical_limitation: all 140 Marmousi train groups were already covered by pre-v6 V4 research, so never-before-opened Marmousi train groups do not exist; the new panels are fresh relative to V6-v10 candidate development and current V9 parent fitting/holdout

allowed: true wavefield frames strictly inside the declared causal prefix
forbidden: truth at or after the observed prefix during adaptation
online_access_contract.scoring_order: serialize and hash the complete candidate before reading the unobserved train suffix

compute_budget.offline_pod: one GPU, at most 60 minutes after V9 parent selection
compute_budget.calibration: four independent GPU arms, at most 30 minutes per arm
compute_budget.confirmation: selected arm only, at most 30 minutes
compute_budget.validation_test: not authorized until train-only confirmation passes and all hashes are frozen

failure_signal: reject if offline per-family POD capacity is nonpositive, if no calibration arm strictly improves, or if the frozen selected arm fails fresh confirmation
rollback: all changes are additive; zero online coefficients reproduce the selected V9 parent exactly; all protected checkpoints remain immutable
pending_bindings_before_launch: selected V9 checkpoint path and SHA256
V9 terminal decision artifact and SHA256
